analyst_view.overall: Early view: Twente (3rd, nine points) have won all three games with two goals conceded and are fourth in the Eredivisie with the league's best defence (12 against in 12 games). Freiburg (14th, six points) are in form: they won at Trabzonspor and have won four in a row, most recently 2-0 against Union Berlin, and Sky Sports had them third in the Bundesliga on 9 November. Freiburg play at Elversberg on 21 November, five days before this.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals. I lean lower: Twente concede very little at home and in Europe, and Freiburg's last European game was a 1-0 win. Freiburg's 3-0 defeat at Monaco shows they can be opened up, but two well-organised teams point to a modest total.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.7 corners. I read nothing about either side's wide play that moves this.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.5 cards. Both are disciplined, well-coached sides and no referee is known yet; I stay with the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.4 shots, split evenly. Freiburg's home form supports their share and Twente's defence limits it; the number looks about right.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target. I lean slightly lower: Twente allowed just two goals in three European games, and Freiburg's recent wins have been narrow rather than shot-heavy.
